subject: Request: Exec exception for Medavant Hosted API structural discount
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec exception for Medavant Hosted API structural discount

Ben — quick summary / ask below. Need an exec exception to approve a one-time structural discount for Medavant so we can secure a 12-month committed contract and avoid churn. Details attached (deal summary, SOW, pricing workup).

Why this matters:
- Account: Medavant (healthcare workflow platform). Currently in pilot (2 regions). If we don’t move to a committed plan they will pause expansion and consider a competing managed endpoint.
- Commercial ask: 30% reduction to our list hosted-API usage rate (applied to token rates) for 12 months starting with their paid contract (target start Jan 1, 2027).
- Financials: expected first-year ARR on committed volume: $480,000. Upside: expansion to 3 additional teams within 12 months (estimated +$600k ARR).
- Risks: increases unit cost; will need quantization + batching guidance from Optimize team to preserve margin.

Requested approval / decision:
- I’m asking for an executive exception to allow a 30% discount (this exceeds standard approval band >20%). If full 30% is not acceptable, we request approval to sign at 25% immediately to secure the deal, with an uplift clause if usage exceeds tiers.
- Required by: EOD Fri, Nov 6 (customer is pushing to finalize procurement calendar week of Nov 8).

Proposed guardrails:
- 12-month committed minimum spend (SOW defines minimum tokens / monthly floor).
- Quarterly usage and quality review; auto-revert to standard rates if usage < floor for two consecutive months.
- Legal to add audit and data residency clauses per their procurement ask (attached SOW v1).

Attachments: medavant_deal_summary_20261104.pdf; SOW_Medavant_v1.docx; pricing_workup.xlsx

Thanks — can you route to Mina + Marcus for sign-off if you’re OK sending? I can prepare DocuSign if we get an approval.

—
Laura Bennett

Subject: Fwd: Request: Exec exception for Medavant Hosted API structural discount

Folks — forwarding Laura’s note. TL;DR: Medavant asking for 30% off hosted-API token pricing for 12 months to lock in a committed contract. First-year ARR on committed volume ~ $480k, material expansion potential.

My read:
- I can authorize up to 25% within our regional sales band with finance & legal sign-off (given the ARR and strategic link).
- Anything >25% should go to Marcus for CRO-level sanction because it materially impacts unit economics and sets a precedent.

Mitigations I recommend if we sign to 25–30%:
1) Push the customer to an 18-month commit if they want >25% (reduces churn risk).
2) Include a usage floor with auto-reversion to list rates if floor missed for 2 consecutive quarters.
3) Apply a phased discount: 30% only applies to committed tier usage; overage billed at standard rates.

Adding finance to confirm margin and legal to finalize SOW language. Laura — keep me posted on the procurement timeline.

Thanks for the context — reviewed the attachments. Finance and I modeled the ask: 30% on token rates for the committed tier would drop expected gross margin below our target unless we secure either a longer commit or more restrictive floors. I can approve a 25% discount today subject to the following conditions being documented in the SOW:

1) Minimum committed spend: align to the monthly floor in the attached finance summary (see finance_summary_medavant.pdf).
2) 18-month term if the customer wants >25% (25% okay for 12 months; 30% requires 18-month minimum).
3) Phased discount language: 30% only applies to committed tier and is not retroactive to overages.
4) Legal to add the audit / data residency clause before signature.

If Marcus approves full 30% (and the executive is comfortable with the financial tradeoffs), we’ll need a one-off margin carve-out in the internal approval system and a note for precedent tracking.

Please confirm whether Medavant can extend to 18 months if we push for the higher discount. Laura — can you check with Samira/Jacob and report back today? Procurement is on a tight timeline.

—
Mina Haddad
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: URGENT: Exec sign-off requested (Medavant) — 30% exception?

Marcus — following up directly given the timeline. Medavant procurement needs a final commercial position by end of day today so they can route for legal counters. Summary:
- Customer requests: 30% off hosted-API token pricing on committed tiers for 12 months, start Jan 1, 2027.
- Our position per internal review: 25% approved by Mina (with finance/legal conditions). 30% requires your sign-off.
- Why I recommend approving 30% in this case: Medavant is the central platform for two hospital systems and we have clear expansion signals (product roadmap integration slated Q2 2027). If we lose this seat to a competitor it would likely slow multiple upcoming expansions and hurt our GTM motion into that healthcare vertical. The risk of margin compression is real but mitigations are in place (commit floors, phased discount, audit rights).

If you approve >25%, I will:
1) Prepare the DocuSign envelope and include the SOW with the 18-month term amendment or the phased discount language as you direct.
2) Notify procurement and legal to fast-track counters.
3) Document internal precedent in the pricing exceptions tracker.

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?token=abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Requested action: Reply with APPROVE 30% (and indicate whether to require 18-month term) or APPROVE 25% (no CRO sign-off needed).

Thanks — I know this is late; appreciate the quick read.
